quote: So it's a single family home. Is there anybody oh, do you already have solar?
stewart_read: Rep discovers existing solar mid-sentence but doesn't slow down to run the orphaned flow properly before moving to ownership question.
coaching_implication: Should have paused to run orphaned_flow questions (own vs lease, company, working condition) before continuing verify.

quote: I've got 10 that are twenty year over twenty five years old.
stewart_read: A 25-year-old system needing replacement is a strong signal, but rep doesn't ask why now, what's failing, or who installed it originally.
coaching_implication: Probe the replacement motive — this is the interest/pain anchor for an orphaned lead and it's walked past.

quote: and then did you get scheduled?
stewart_read: Rep asks a closed yes/no about a prior appointment instead of confirming date, time, and who it's with — no button-up occurs at all.
alternative_hypothesis: Strategic: rep may assume this is a duplicate/recycled lead already handled elsewhere and is closing efficiently.
coaching_implication: Even if scheduled elsewhere, rep should confirm date/time and note it for the record instead of taking a bare 'yes' and hanging up.

quote: Oh, then you're all good. Sorry to bother you.
stewart_read: Call ends with an apology and no verification of any appointment detail, no recap, no next step owned by the rep.
coaching_implication: Any exit should still confirm what's already on the books before ending — 'just to confirm, what day and time do you have?'

quote: I'm reaching out about the solar form you filled out online.
stewart_read: Intro references the form for legitimacy per script, adequate but minimal — no state or company anchor beyond name.
coaching_implication: Acceptable per standard intro template; not a major gap given customer's immediate cooperation.

quote: Are you able to access the power bill, like, online?
stewart_read: Bill of $200 captured earlier but never reflected back or used — rep moves straight to bill-document logistics without any acknowledgment of the number.
coaching_implication: Should have flipped the $200 bill into a reason to act before pivoting to document collection.
